scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man seated apart on a rocky rise clutches a basket of fruit and turns away with one hand raised toward three villagers gesturing to him below. A sunlit stone village and hills stretch behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene relates to Proverbs 18:1 by portraying a man seeking his own desire in isolation and angrily turning away from counsel.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling seated man points toward his chest and gestures outward while looking away from another seated man, who reaches toward him with open hands. A vine-covered pergola, pottery, fruit, and distant village buildings surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene portraying the contrast in Proverbs 18:2 between delighting in understanding and expressing one’s own heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man strides through a stone village gateway beside an overturned basket of fruit, looking disdainfully toward a distressed merchant as villagers react with sorrow and reproach.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative village encounter illustrates Proverbs 18:3, associating the arrival of the wicked with contempt, dishonor, and reproach.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to a seated listener beside a deep blue pool, while a brook cascades over rocks into the water; trees, hills, and a distant village fill the sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by the verse's comparison of a man's words to deep waters and wisdom's wellspring to a flowing brook.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone town gate, a richly dressed man offers a pouch to a seated judge beside a tilted balance, while a plainly dressed man waits with an outstretched hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative court scene illustrates the warning against favoring the wicked and denying justice to the righteous in Proverbs 18:5.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a man gestures and shouts at another man who raises a fist. An older man holds up his hands between them as worried bystanders look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts contentious speech leading toward the blows described in Proverbs 18:6.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a startled man stumbles as a golden cord emerging from his mouth loops around his ankle, while four nearby villagers recoil in concern.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of the fool whose mouth brings destruction and whose lips become a snare to his own life in Proverbs 18:7.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man leans in to whisper to a seated man, who holds a sweet morsel near his mouth and rests his other hand on his abdomen. A bowl of sweets sits on the table between them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects a talebearer's enticing words with the tasty morsels that, in Proverbs 18:8, go down into the inmost body.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated worker rests beside unused tools and an unfinished stone wall while another man breaks a section of the wall with a hammer; fallen stones lie between them, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 18:9's comparison between slackness in work and destruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler runs along a rocky path toward the warmly lit open doorway of a tall stone tower, with dark storm clouds behind it and a sunlit village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler seeking refuge in a strong tower, reflecting Proverbs 18:10's image of the righteous running to the name of Yahweh and being safe.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man sits beside gold coins and vessels, looking toward a vast walled city appearing among clouds above a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the rich man's wealth as a fortified city and high wall in his own esteem, as described in Proverbs 18:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man stands proudly on crumbling steps while a man kneels to help a woman gather spilled fruit, and another woman watches nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts pride on unstable steps with humble help and the respect it receives, reflecting Proverbs 18:12.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a standing man raises his hand as he speaks to a seated man gesturing across a table, while three onlookers react nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts an interruption as a visual reflection on Proverbs 18:13, which warns of the folly and shame of answering before hearing.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man rests beneath woven blankets on a bed, gazing upward, while a woman sits nearby with her head bowed and her hands in her lap. An oil lamp glows beside the bed in a sunlit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 18:14 between a spirit that sustains a person in sickness and the burden of a broken spirit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young learner leans toward an older man who holds a leafy sprig and gestures as he speaks. Potted plants, pottery and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of attentive learning reflects the prudent heart acquiring knowledge and the wise ear seeking it in Proverbs 18:15.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carrying an ornate gift walks through a crowd opening a path toward seated elders in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 18:16: a person's gift makes room for him and brings him before great people.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At an ancient stone town gate, a seated man gestures earnestly toward a thoughtful elder, while a standing man gestures as he addresses them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of one person presenting his case and another questioning him, reflecting Proverbs 18:17.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder casts small stones onto a low stone table while two richly dressed leaders stand apart on either side, smiling toward one another.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of casting lots to end contentions and keep the mighty apart, as in Proverbs 18:18.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man reaches toward another man standing with folded arms behind the heavily barred wooden gate of a stone city. Fortified walls rise beyond them in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the proverb's comparison of an offended brother and contention to a strong city and the bars of a castle.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, a seated man with one hand on his belly speaks to a neighbor across a table of fruit and bread. An imaginative spray of flowering branches and figs flows from his mouth toward the food.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Proverbs 18:20, linking the fruit of a person’s speech with being satisfied by its produce.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a bitten pomegranate gestures toward a woman listening beneath a tree with ripe fruit and a withered branch; hills and a village lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the fruit and contrasting branches with the proverb’s picture of life and death in the power of the tongue and eating its fruit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling husband and wife hold hands outside a stone home in a sunlit courtyard, with grapevines overhead, flowers, pottery, olive trees and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the goodness of finding a wife and suggests the favor from Yahweh described in Proverbs 18:22.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in worn clothes kneels with his hands extended toward a richly dressed seated man, who raises a hand dismissively and looks stern.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the contrast in Proverbs 18:23 between the poor man’s entreaties and the rich man’s rough answer.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler and his friend sit closely together on a stone step in a sunlit hillside village. The friend puts an arm around the traveler's shoulders and offers him a cup, while villagers greet one another along the path behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of friendly community and a faithful friend staying close, reflecting Proverbs 18:24.
